description: smime_policy sets max_path_len=1 and code_signing_policy sets max_path_len=1, but there are no tests asserting these values (no field-value assertion and no enforcement test). Compare: web_pki_policy lacks a max_path_len test too. All three profiles set max_path_len but none have a test like 'web_pki_policy_max_path_len_is_2'. P3: correctness of the values is clear from code inspection; enforcement is exercised by validate_path tests (path_too_long_returns_error). Gap is observable by someone adding a profile and forgetting max_path_len.
title: smime/code_signing: no test for max_path_len enforcement
